snippet.title: LURKS WITHIN WALLS + GOG Trailer
snippet.description:
LURKS WITHIN WALLS is a tense survival horror game that combines modern dungeon-crawling RPG with fast-paced turn-based combat. Explore cursed environments infested with creatures born from the haunted art of Trevor Henderson.

“I've never been more curious about a game, I'm not gonna lie. This is what I love about indie games, we always get something fresh and new.”
8-Bit Ryan

“Every sharp turn is an opportunity for a scare - it's as though you were viewing one of those slidereel shows 80s horror movies love, waiting for the one that has the spook.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

“Very good game aesthetically, and I don't mean just the monsters.”
ManlyBadassHero

Wishlist now
